missing_rule: If a required feature cannot be computed, pass Float.nan, not 0. Core ML routes NaN through XGBoost learned missing branches.
training_scope: 77 subjects: 15 controls, 62 Parkinson; all-common uses tests 0 and 1 only.
medical_warning: Research screening model only. Labels are diagnosed Parkinson's disease versus healthy control, not early-stage disease. The all cohort contains a PD-only second acquisition batch and is vulnerable to acquisition-batch confounding.
